:::{#hero-heading}

<p style='text-align: justify;'>
I'm Niklas Hlubek, an interdisciplinary quantitative researcher interested in improving our understanding of complex societal challenges through data. I have expertise in generating evidence-based insights by integrating diverse data sources, from psychological questionnaires and policy data to large-scale population registers and environmental data.

</p>

<p style='text-align: justify;'>
In my current role as a PhD research fellow in Epidemiology at Utrecht University Medical Center, I am analyzing nationwide longitudinal data to evaluate the impact of social and environmental factors on public health. This project combines causal inference, spatial analysis, and time-to-event modeling to inform policy. I strive to translate complex findings into actionable strategies for decision-makers.
</p>

<p style='text-align: justify;'>
Core Competencies:

-   Quantitative Analysis & Modeling: Applying causal inference, longitudinal data analysis, and spatial models to complex, real-world data.

-   Evaluation & Monitoring: Designing studies and developing indicators to assess the impact of policies and interventions.

-   Data Visualization: Communicating insights through clear reports, presentations, and interactive dashboards for diverse audiences.

-   Interdisciplinary Problem-Solving: Bridging insights from public health, social policy, psychology, and environmental science.

Background: 

**Psychological Research (MSc)** • **Social Policy & Public Health (MSc)** • **Epidemiology (PhD)**

*Explore my [research projects](/projects.qmd) or learn more [about my work](/about.qmd).*
</p>

:::
